About the exercises & PJVI references

These 20 melodies and their accompaniment were written for this app. PJVI Vocal Studio’s public teaching examples informed the practice approach: pentatonic shapes, small connected figures, short runs, vowel continuity, and rests between phrases. These are original studies, not PJVI transcriptions or official PJVI exercises. This app is not affiliated with PJVI.

Opening notation reviewed: R&B Vocal Warm Up, R&B Vocal Exercise #2, and R&B Vocal Warm Up #3. Explore the original lessons at PJVI Vocal Studio.

Drum patterns are original arrangements of common R&B rhythms, with synthesized sounds. Rhythm reference. Piano samples: Alexander Holm · CC BY 3.0. MIDI files use standard piano, bass, and channel-10 drums. Sound varies by MIDI player.
